description: List a company's journal entries (id, postedOn, createdOn, journalLines with accountRef/netAmount/currency). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/journalEntries. Returns the paged envelope.

orderBy.description: Field to order results by, e.g. "-modifiedDate" (leading "-" for descending).

query.description: Codat query filter string, e.g. "status=Paid" or "modifiedDate>2026-01-01". See docs.codat.io/using-the-api/querying.

name: codat_list_journal_entries
title: List journal entries
